verdict.rationale: Cloudflare ships a fleet of managed remote MCP servers explicitly described as letting users 'connect to Cloudflare's service from an MCP client (e.g. Cursor, Claude) and use natural language to accomplish tasks through your Cloudflare account,' backed by a dedicated agent-setup onboarding hub, a Skills plugin for major agents, and live probes confirming working keyless and OAuth-gated MCP endpoints. This directly satisfies operating the platform (deploys, bindings, observability, DNS, etc.) via natural-language commands. Missing for 10: independent/community hands-on accounts specifically validating the natural-language MCP workflow (evidence is entirely first-party docs plus technical probes, no third-party user testimonial of this exact flow).
